memories.title: Cedar invoices
memories.content: Cedar invoices require a purchase-order identifier before posting to the ledger.

memories.title: Cedar exceptions
memories.content: Cedar invoice exceptions are reviewed by Nisha. Nisha's queue code is CDR-73.

memories.title: Nisha reporting preference
memories.content: Nisha requests weekly exception summaries as CSV attachments, with amounts in euros.

memories.title: Returns workflow
memories.content: For Cedar returns: verify the receipt, record the return authorization, inspect the package, then issue a credit note.

memories.title: Cedar current payment terms
memories.content: Effective August 15, 2026, Cedar invoices are payable within 45 days. The former 30-day term no longer applies to new invoices.

memories.title: Cedar June payment terms
memories.content: In June 2026, Cedar payment terms were 30 days.

memories.title: Boreal payment terms
memories.content: Boreal invoices are payable within 90 days; their exception reviewer is Luis.

memories.title: Cedar import checkpoint
memories.content: The Cedar import job finished file CDR-016. Resume with CDR-017. The duplicate-review step remains blocked on approval.

memories.title: Currency display
memories.content: Cedar financial statements display euros using the EUR currency code.

memories.title: Sandbox environment
memories.content: The invoice sandbox uses endpoint invoice-test.internal and cannot post to the production ledger.
